items.text: Onboarding checklist: Please complete your I-9 form by Friday and upload it to the HR portal. The assistant will confirm receipt and notify payroll.

items.text: Library loan notice: Your loan of 'Design Patterns' is due on May 10. The assistant can renew it automatically if you reply 'renew'.

items.text:

The audit report is available on the intranet.
